passage:
F: Can I take this sheet with me now? The top feels dry, but the bottom is still stuck to the cloth.
M: Leave it flat on the cloth for now. The two empty trays by the door are for sheets that lift off without bending.
F: I have to go before the workshop closes. Can I leave it here until tomorrow?
M: Yes. Write your name on the little holder that grips the cloth. Do not write on the paper. We will set your sheet on a shelf so it can dry. The trays are for people taking their sheets home today.
passageZh:
F：這張紙我現在能帶走嗎？上面摸起來是乾的，但底下還黏在布上。
M：先讓它平放在布上。門邊那兩個空托盤，是給拿起來不會彎折的紙張用的。
F：我得在工作坊結束前離開。可以留到明天再拿嗎？
M：可以。把名字寫在夾住布的小夾子上，不要寫在紙上。我們會把你的紙放到架上晾乾。托盤留給今天要帶作品回家的人。
